mapper.select: SELECT chat_message_no, session_no, seq, direction, node_no, option_no, content, content_ciphertext, content_key_id, content_encryption_version, payload::text AS payload, latency_ms, frst_reg_dt FROM tb_chat_message WHERE session_no = #{sessionId}::uuid ORDER BY seq, chat_message_no

SELECT m.chat_message_no, m.session_no, m.seq, m.direction, m.node_no, m.option_no, m.content, m.content_ciphertext, m.content_key_id, m.content_encryption_version, m.payload::text AS payload, m.latency_ms, m.frst_reg_dt, fb.rating AS feedback_rating, fb.comment AS feedback_comment, fb.comment_ciphertext AS feedback_comment_ciphertext, fb.comment_key_id AS feedback_comment_key_id, fb.comment_encryption_version AS feedback_comment_encryption_version FROM tb_chat_message m LEFT JOIN tb_chat_feedback fb ON fb.message_no = m.chat_message_no WHERE m.session_no = #{sessionId}::uuid ORDER BY m.seq, m.chat_message_no

SELECT chat_message_no, session_no, seq, direction, node_no, option_no, content, content_ciphertext, content_key_id, content_encryption_version, payload::text AS payload, latency_ms, frst_reg_dt FROM tb_chat_message WHERE chat_message_no = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM tb_chat_message WHERE session_no = #{sessionId}::uuid

SELECT chat_message_no AS id, content AS plaintext, content_ciphertext AS ciphertext, content_key_id AS key_id FROM tb_chat_message WHERE content_ciphertext IS NULL AND content IS NOT NULL AND content != '' AND content != '[encrypted]' ORDER BY chat_message_no LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT chat_message_no AS id, content AS plaintext, content_ciphertext AS ciphertext, content_key_id AS key_id FROM tb_chat_message WHERE content_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND content_key_id IS NOT NULL AND content_key_id != #{activeKeyId} ORDER BY chat_message_no LIMIT #{limit}
